root_cause: Netlify production, deploy-preview and exact-local fallback carried independent copies of the same long mutation pipeline. Static locale generation parsed and serialized every public route serially, and a missing provider preview could trigger a second identical local build instead of reusing the already-required parity output.
prevention: One canonical runner owns the build order and emits per-step timing evidence. Static localized routes are sharded deterministically across a bounded worker count. Required publishes an immutable candidate-SHA build artifact; the browser fallback waits boundedly for and verifies that artifact before rebuilding. Material writeback closure must remain shallow-safe by fetching explicit missing BASE/HEAD commits and using exact two-tree diff rather than merge-base-dependent triple-dot diff.
